STA unused_0076
    LDA ru_lo
    AND #&F8                        \ line 0 of this cell, then up those cells
    SEC
    SBC ru_cells_lo,Y
    STA ru_lo                       \ L1, a multiple of 8 (ru_cells_lo is &00 or &80)
    TXA
    SBC ru_cells_hi,Y
    CMP #&40                        \ round the 16K screen
    BCS ru_in_ring
    ADC #&40
.ru_in_ring
    LDY ru_lo                       \ step 2 (grind): the high byte first. C: no borrow from L1 - &79
    CPY #&80                        \ (L1 >= &79 is L1 >= &80)
    SBC #&02                        \ as the subroutine's SBC delta_high: the same N V Z C
    CMP #&40                        \ round the 16K screen
    BCS ru_in_ring_2
    ADC #&40
.ru_in_ring_2
    TAX
    LDA ru_d                        \ then &0279 up, and up the rest of the rows inside that cell:
    AND #&07                        \ (L1 - &79) AND &F8 = L1 EOR &80, with its line 7 - (d AND 7)
    EOR #&87                        \ (C and V stay as the crossing left them)
    EOR ru_lo
.ru_done                            \ the rows inside the cell: A = the low byte
    TAY
    STZ unused_0076                 \ 65C02 opcode; 0 (Z and N are read by no caller)
    RTS
candidates.new:
LDA ru_lo
    AND #&F8                        \ line 0 of this cell, then up those cells
    SEC
    SBC ru_cells_lo,Y
    STA unused_0076                 \ L1, a multiple of 8 (ru_cells_lo is &00 or &80); the rows are counted (the one read of &76 is done): scratch
    TXA
    SBC ru_cells_hi,Y               \ X is &40-&7F: less at most &11 and a borrow, &2E-&7F
    LDY unused_0076
    CPY #&80                        \ (L1 >= &79 is L1 >= &80): C = no borrow from L1 - &79
    SBC #&02                        \ as the subroutine's SBC delta_high
    ORA #&40                        \ round the 16K screen: &2B-&7F; below &40 add &40, else keep = set bit 6 (one wrap for the pair: the first leaves &40-&7F)
    TAX
    LDA ru_d                        \ then &0279 up, and up the rest of the rows inside that cell:
    AND #&07                        \ (L1 - &79) AND &F8 = L1 EOR &80, with its line 7 - (d AND 7)
    EOR #&87
    EOR unused_0076
.ru_done                            \ the rows inside the cell: A = the low byte
    TAY                             \ (C, V, Z, N are read by no caller; unused_0076 is written by both entries' callers before it is read)

candidates.summary: rows_up's crossing tail: drop the dead STA unused_0076 (1) and the dead STZ unused_0076 at ru_done, keep L1 in zero page &76 instead of ru_lo (three accesses, 1 cycle each), and fold the two 16K ring wraps (CMP/BCS/ADC twice) into one ORA #&40. About 68 -> 51 cycles on the crossing path, 3 fewer on the inside-cell path, 17 bytes. The other three candidates are alternatives that overlap this one.
candidates.equivalence: Crossing path only (the inside-cell path BRAs to ru_done and is untouched). Dead store: the STA unused_0076 of 1 at 5821 is overwritten (by the scratch use below, or the STZ) before anything reads &76: reads of &76 in the whole program are CMP/SBC/ADC in rows_up's own entry before this point and DEC in add_Y_rows after its own STY (probe over 5,000 world-bot passes: reads of &76 only at those pcs, each after a write). L1 is kept in &76 instead of ru_lo: ru_lo is read nowhere after this point and rewritten by rows_up's next STA; the interrupt and the renderer never touch &76 (grep: game.6502 1739/1744/1752 and the routine only; bank5's unused_0076 + 1 is &77). The two ring wraps become one: with X in &40-&7F (every screen address starts at screen_start_address_high and passes the ring wrap of add/subtract delta) and Y <= 7 (rows - line - 1 < 64; measured max rows 46, Y max 4), v1 = X - hi[Y] - b1 is &2E-&7F and t = v1 - 2 - b2 is &2B-&7F, never negative; the original's w(w(v1) - 2 - b2) = w(t) for all such values (a model over a 0-255, X &40-&7F, rows 1-71: 1,105,920 cases, 0 differences; and on the emulator 20,000 calls of the real subtract_Y_rows_from_screen_address_in_AX on the base and each candidate build, A X Y hashed identically). C and V on exit change (the original left C = 1 if no wrap, V = 0 here); Z and N are already free; no caller reads them (see relies_on). Registers out: A = Y = low byte, X = high byte, as before. delta_low/high (&79/&02) are set before the window and untouched. passlock (bench build, base vs this candidate, --screen): state and screen identical over 6,000 passes seed 1 and 4,000 passes seed 3. The STZ at ru_done is dropped too: nothing reads &76 before its next write (STY in both entry stubs), so the 0 it left is not observable; passlock compares the mover tables, score, fuel table and named zero-page variables, none of them &76.
candidates.relies_on: X (screen address high byte) in &40-&7F on entry and Y = (rows - line - 1) >> 3 <= 7 so ru_cells_hi,Y <= &11 (the original reads past the 8-byte tables above that); &76 read only after a write (STY) in subtract_Y_rows/add_Y_rows; no caller reads C or V after the call. Callers of rows_up (via subtract_Y_rows_from_screen_address_in_AX, game.6502 lines 1948, 1965, 2883, 4221) take A, X and Y only: after 1948/1965 plot_mover_sprite starts STA/STX/LDA/STA and walk_column CLCs before any carry use; 2883's return goes to JSR move_mover_up/down then JMP move_mover_right (CLC first) or move_mover_left (SEC first); 4221 goes to add_Y_rows (STY, BEQ, INC/BIT, and add_delta CLCs). ru_in_ring and ru_in_ring_2 are referenced nowhere else (grep src/ tools/). ru_done is reached by BRA from the inside-cell path (A = low byte, X untouched), unchanged. Page crossings: ru_cells_lo/hi (8+8 bytes) and ru_lo/ru_d stay in one page in every build (bench 0A7E-0A8D from 0A8F-0A9E; the gameplay build, org &0982, from &09F1 moves down the same way); ground_columns stays in one page (0C42 from 0C53; gameplay 0BA4 from 0BB5, um_next likewise) so the ASSERTs at 5921/5925 hold; no hot code follows the section and the level tables after it are read under 0.05 times a pass. No branch in the new code crosses a page, and ru_done's BRA only gets shorter. Measured on the bench build (DEBUG_LIVES, pcprof, 1500 passes from 500, seed 1): logic work 9440 -> 9414 cycles a pass (-26), render unchanged.
